name: podman
description_en: Podman: A tool for managing OCI containers and pods.
readme_excerpt: Podman: A tool for managing OCI containers and pods Podman (the POD MANager) is a tool for managing containers and images, volumes mounted into those containers, and pods made from groups of containers. Podman runs containers on Linux, but can also be used on Mac and Windows systems using a Podman-managed virtual machine.
